<thought>The spectrum shows a dominant peak at m/z 194.09, a clear M+2 peak at m/z 196.08 with about one‑third the intensity of the monoisotopic peak, and a very small M+4 peak. This pattern matches the characteristic isotopic distribution of chlorine (35Cl/37Cl ≈ 3:1). The noticeable M+1 peak (~13 % of the base peak) is consistent with the natural abundance of 13C in a molecule containing roughly a dozen carbons, indicating carbon is also present. No other element shows a distinctive pattern that can be confirmed definitively. Therefore, the elements that can be definitively identified are chlorine and carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl', 'C']</final_answer>
